objective: Test local versus branch-global credit on real multi-call RLM episodes using trace-derived whole-episode counterfactual replay without text splicing or outcome-conditioned retries.

arm_factorization.reconstruction_qa_arm: Replay every recorded action only when the complete recorded request key matches. Require exact terminal artifacts and reward. Exclude this arm from LOO advantages and scientific statistics.
arm_factorization.scientific_branch_group: The recorded target action plus K-1 fresh IID target actions from the deployed behavior policy. Every member, including the recorded-target member, freshly regenerates all post-target policy calls.
arm_factorization.continuation_coupling: Corresponding stable post-target call slots use the same continuation seed across all K arms.
arm_factorization.decision_unit: One source rollout/paper. All precommitted child targets are retained and receive equal outer weights summing to one within that rollout.

required_fields: exact rendered prompt token IDs and SHA-256
exact typed messages and tool schema
exact action token IDs and SHA-256
behavior logprobs for every action token
finish reason and typed assistant message
exact_action_key.sandbox_paths: Use one canonical model-visible /workspace path in every arm. Do not treat different prompt text as exact merely by normalizing paths.
exact_action_key.request_projection_role: The OpenAI request projection is an additional transport assertion, not a substitute for exact rendered-token equality.

forbidden_inputs: alternative replicate for corresponding continuation calls
seed_namespaces.collision_rule: Two distinct policy calls may never share a continuation seed slot. A collision is a deterministic ineligibility, not a silent retry.

behavior_policy_sampling.typed_actions: Support terminal text and tool-call actions, including continued child execution. Inject the candidate's own typed message, finish reason, tokens, logprobs, and usage.

topology_and_failure_policy.stable_new_event_address: trace ID, target ID, arm role, depth, and ordinal call slot; generated identifiers are diagnostic only
topology_and_failure_policy.scientific_failure_reward: Timeouts, parse failures, missing generated invocation IDs, runtime exceptions, and resource-limit exits after a model call receive the task's frozen failure reward and remain in the denominator.
topology_and_failure_policy.infrastructure_failure: Only a demonstrated outcome-independent failure before an arm's first model call may be versioned and redeployed under the bounded repair rule.
topology_and_failure_policy.terminal_without_downstream_resample: Valid when the injected action ends the episode or changes reward through environment execution.

shared_frozen_state: Python, NumPy, and Torch RNG state
environment_coupling.nondeterminism_floor: Repeat regenerated-original arms before interpreting small continuous differences.

scoring_and_statistics.scorer: Frozen deterministic evidence span precision, recall, and F1 with parse failures retained as failures.
scoring_and_statistics.primary_credit_contrast: local versus branch-global at matched source data, target actions, optimizer updates, and policy-call budget
scoring_and_statistics.stock_economic_contrast: stock incumbent curve reported separately at matched generated-token and GPU-hour ledgers

training_bridge.required_cpu_regression: Serialize target action tokens, behavior logprobs, rewards, all-branch LOO advantages, outer decision-unit weights, and trainer-ready records; byte-verify reload and execute the intended frozen Prime-RL loss on the batch.

minimum_non_scientific_gpu_smoke_gate: full typed behavior action and logprob capture
frozen topology, failure, and resource-limit rules
signed compact raw evidence and workspace manifests
adversarial tests for duplicates, terminal-without-resample, added and removed calls, tool-call candidates, exception, timeout, and cross-paper seed uniqueness
fresh scientific and extra-high runtime code reviews

gpu_policy.next_authorization: A new preregistration may authorize one bounded engineering smoke only after every minimum gate passes.

retain: source, runtime, and artifact SHA-256 manifests
artifact_policy.compression: Compress terminal evidence bundles locally; keep files needed for independent verification directly addressable.
